verdict.rationale: Pilot documents its own reporting capability: custom reporting, consolidated reporting for foreign subsidiaries, and real-time account data in its portal. Community customers describe the books as accurate. However, no evidence names P&L, balance sheet, or cash-flow statements, or shows they can be generated on demand for any arbitrary period. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of P&L, balance sheet and cash-flow statement outputs, on-demand self-serve generation for any period, and hands-on corroboration of statement generation.

support.subject: As a founder, I can generate an accurate P&L, balance sheet, and cash-flow statement for any period on demand

citations.quote: We can also provide US entities with foreign subsidiaries with consolidated reporting.
stay up to date with real time account data directly in the portal
Pilot is super accurate and timely.
